answer_1.quote: We aim to address temporal misalignment in knowledge-intensive tasks, such as open-retrieval QA.

answer_2.quote: We consider following calibration metrics: • AUROC: Area under the ROC curve evaluates a calibration system's performance at classifying correct and incorrect predictions over all possible confidence thresholds. • Expected Calibration Error (ECE): Computed by ordering predictions by estimated confidence then partitioning into 10 equally sized buckets. ECE is then macro-averaged absolute error each bucket's average confidence and accuracy. • Risk Control (RC@XX): Uncertainty estimates are often used for selective-prediction...
